_about: T632 (owner 2026-11-11): every piece the reach run could not place (any reason: straddles_the_cut, meets_the_line_at_the_cut, flows_to_the_sea_unjoined, leaves_bc_unjoined, ...) STOPS the run unless a row in `accepted` names it. Key: entry_id (a synopsis entry, or a DFO location id with kind "dfo"), rule_id ("" for an entry's scope or a DFO place), piece (section id), reason. An accepted row needs accepted_by + accepted_on; a row naming no piece of the run (stale) stops it too. `proposed` rows are NOT accepted: they are Claude's proposals for the owner, read by nothing; to accept one, move it to `accepted` and add accepted_by / accepted_on. A provincial piece that straddles a cut is never accepted (the straddle gate, T67: the atlas's braid sweep must cut it). Authored by the owner; read by pipeline.atlas.reach.build.load_unplaced_calls (reach run).

proposed.note: Noons Creek (gnis:23366), an added-stream piece of 2,199 m that reaches the sea without joining the creek's own line. The rule is 'No Fishing upstream of railway bridge'. Not checked whether the piece lies upstream of the bridge: if it does, accepting leaves closed water shown open; the alternative is a cut or an extent that places it.

Seymour River (gnis:6105), an added-stream piece of 216 m that reaches the sea without joining the river's own line. The rule is 'No Fishing downstream of Seymour Lake'. Not checked whether it lies in that stretch.

Skeena River side channel (1,488 m) at the DFO place 'mainstem waters near the Kitsumkalum River mouth, Zymagotitz confluence to the top of Hell's Gate'. The atlas's braid sweep REFUSED this cut (skeena_river__kitsumkalum_river_into_skeena_river_u1500m, 'refused: line misses' in braid_sweep.json): its perpendicular at the cut crosses none of the braid's channels, so the channels that join the Skeena both above and below the cut were never cut (residual_straddles lists 360220098 and 360220099). The real fix is in the atlas (the sweep, or the cut's place), not an acceptance; accepting keeps these 7.5 km of side channel out of the place until then.
Skeena River side channel (3,262 m) joining the Skeena on both sides of the Kitsumkalum +1500 m cut; same cause as 360220078 (braid sweep 'refused: line misses').
Skeena River side channel (2,699 m) joining the Skeena at m 119,499 (below the cut at m 123,961) and m 125,470-127,295 (above it); same cause as 360220078.
